title: Tomorrowland Terrace Restaurant | Walt Disney World Resort
body_text: Tomorrowland Terrace Restaurant Located in Tomorrowland at Magic Kingdom Park Treat your senses to a sensational dessert party with views of the Magic Kingdom nighttime spectacular! American Dining Plan Meals Not Accepted Valid admission required. A theme park reservation may be required based on admission type. An Important Message At this time, Tomorrowland Terrace Restaurant is only open for Magic Kingdom Fireworks Dessert Parties; quick-service dining is temporarily unavailable.
